{{nihongo|'''Umorihiko Shrine'''|宇母理比古神社}} is a shrine located in {{ill|Hata, Tokushima|Q11390732|qid=Q11390732}}, {{ill|Tokushima (city)|Q207309|qid=Q207309}}, {{ill|Tokushima Prefecture|Q160734|qid=Q160734}}. {{nihongo|'''Umorihiko Shrine'''|宇母理比古神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Awa Province (Tokushima)]].

== Enshrined deity ==
* '''Uganomori no Kami''' - also said to be another name for {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Ugayafukiaezu no Mikoto}}.

== History ==
The founding date is unknown. It is an {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Engishiki shrine|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}. This old shrine was also called "Umori Daimyōjin" and "Moritoki Daimyōjin." Flooding of the nearby {{ill|Hata River|Q11390730|qid=Q11390730|lt=Hatta River}} caused the loss of the shrine buildings and old documents. In 1875 (Meiji 8), it was ranked as a {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}.
